description: Defines an abstract class MockZigbeeDevice representing a mock Zigbee device with properties, endpoints, and cluster management methods.

classes.name: MockZigbeeDevice
classes.description: An abstract class representing a mock Zigbee device with properties like name, endpoints, and cluster management.

methods.name: MockZigbeeDevice
methods.description: Constructors for initializing a MockZigbeeDevice with various parameters.

methods.name: getRandomEui64
methods.description: Generates a random EUI64 string.

methods.name: isDiscovered
methods.description: Returns whether the device has been discovered.

methods.name: setDiscovered
methods.description: Sets the discovered status of the device.

methods.name: isRouter
methods.description: Checks if the device is a router.

methods.name: isMainsPowered
methods.description: Checks if the device is mains powered.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves a specific endpoint by ID.

methods.name: getEui64
methods.description: Returns the device's EUI64 identifier.

methods.name: isDefaulted
methods.description: Checks if the device is defaulted based on its basic cluster.

methods.name: setDefaulted
methods.description: Sets the defaulted status of the device.

methods.name: getEndpointIds
methods.description: Returns sorted array of enabled endpoint IDs.

methods.name: getEndpointsByZigbeeDeviceId
methods.description: Returns endpoints matching a specific device ID.

methods.name: joinComplete
methods.description: Placeholder for join completion logic.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent EUI64.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent EUI64.

methods.name: findServerClusterOfType
methods.description: Finds a server cluster of a specific type.

methods.name: findRequiredServerClusterOfType
methods.description: Finds a required server cluster of a specific type, throws if not found.

methods.name: findClientClusterOfType
methods.description: Finds a client cluster of a specific type.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves the manufacturer from the basic cluster.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model from the basic cluster.

methods.name: getZigbeeHardwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the hardware version from the basic cluster.

methods.name: getZigbeeFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version from the OTA upgrade cluster.

methods.name: getFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Formats the firmware version as a hex string.

methods.name: getHardwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the hardware version as a string.
